decision.reason: [ev-13278d059ceb] puts at least three separate changes under one heading: LOGGING_CONFIG, ASSUME_ROLE_ARN and ASSUME_ROLE_DURATION are dropped; LEADER_ELECT is renamed to DISABLE_LEADER_ELECTION; and FEATURE_GATES.DRIFT is promoted to Stable and can no longer be disabled. These have different subjects and change types, so they can't become one typed assertion. The excerpt also leaves gaps. It doesn't say what replaces the dropped variables, or what happens if they are still set. It doesn't say how values map across the LEADER_ELECT rename, even though the name now flips the meaning to "disable". Only the drift part states a consequence: operators who opted out of drift can no longer do so.
